newsitem.title: USA: Rubin-Japan should seek sustained economic growth.
newsitem.headline: Rubin-Japan should seek sustained economic growth.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Wednesday Japan should watch its fiscal and monetary policy in an effort to achieve sustained economic growth.
Meeting briefly with reporters following remarks unveiling a U.S. savings bond sales program for Hispanics, Rubin said Japan "needs to watch its fiscal and monetary policy."

Asked about a meeting of the International Monetary Fund executive board on Wednesday on a debt reduction plan for poor countries, Rubin said he would like to see that program, which involves the sale of some gold, approved but was uncertain whether it would be accomplished now or at the upcoming annual meeting.
